newsitem.title: USA: DuPont sees higher growth for nylon business.
newsitem.headline: DuPont sees higher growth for nylon business.

text.p: DuPont Co expects the modernization of its North American and European plants to lead to stronger growth of its nylon business in mature markets, the general manager of the company's global nylon business said Thursday.

Speaking to reporters on a teleconference, Ed Van Wely said a five-year renewal program, announced earlier Thursday, would boost capacity of the plants through greater efficiency. "And because of lower costs, (the business) is expected to grow in traditional markets faster than it has recently."
